The '''Emergency Response Team''', also known as the '''ERT''', was a response unit that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The team was made up [[Fire/Legends|fire]] fighters, [[Medic/Legends|medical personnel]] and rescue experts, and they used a large, black-colored [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]] as their means of transport. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ERT responded to an explosion at a restaurant on Cularin and with the help of a [[Heroes of Cularin|group]] of freelance agents, they were able to bring the situation at the dining establishment under control.
